EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
I received guidance back from our Data Privacy team regarding granting your International Employees access to the Insperity Premier Performance Management system. We can proceed with granting your International Employees access to the Insperity Premier Performance Management system at this time. I will need you to provide the attached Notice to your Employees so they will be aware of their data being utilized within the system.
Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.
Thank you,
